OPTIONAL MATCH (t:Tdoc) WHERE t.tdocNumber = 'R3-237507' OR t.id = 'R3-237507'
WITH collect(DISTINCT t) AS ts
OPTIONAL MATCH (r:CR) WHERE r.tdocNumber = 'R3-237507' OR r.id = 'R3-237507'
WITH ts + collect(DISTINCT r) AS cs
UNWIND (CASE WHEN size(cs) = 0 THEN [null] ELSE cs END) AS c
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p1:CRPack)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p2:CRPack)-[:HAS_CR]->(c)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d1:DecisionDisposition)-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]->(c)
WITH collect(DISTINCT p1) + collect(DISTINCT p2) AS packs, collect(DISTINCT d1) AS dds1
OPTIONAL MATCH (d2:DecisionDisposition) WHERE d2.targetTdocNumber = 'R3-237507'
WITH packs, dds1 + collect(DISTINCT d2) AS dds
WITH packs, [d IN dds WHERE
  replace(replace(replace(toLower(coalesce(toString(d.dispositionCode), '')), '_', ''), '-', ''), ' ', '') =~ '.*(withdraw|nottreated|notpursued|reject|notagreed|notapproved|nothandled|withoutapproval).*'
  AND NOT replace(replace(replace(toLower(coalesce(toString(d.evidenceStatus), '')), '_', ''), '-', ''), ' ', '') =~ '.*(unverified|notverified|notfound|missing|unresolved|insufficient|absent).*'
] AS closing
UNWIND (CASE
  WHEN size(packs) > 0 THEN [p IN packs | [p.crPackId, p.tsgMeeting]]
  WHEN size(closing) > 0 THEN []
  ELSE [['INSUFFICIENT_RECORDS', 'INSUFFICIENT_RECORDS']]
END) AS row
RETURN DISTINCT row[0] AS cr_pack, row[1] AS tsg_meeting

UNWIND (CASE WHEN size(cs) = 0 THEN [null] ELSE cs END) AS c
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p1:CRPack)
OPTIONAL MATCH (p2:CRPack)-[:HAS_CR]->(c)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d1:DecisionDisposition)-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]->(c)
WITH collect(DISTINCT p1) + collect(DISTINCT p2) AS packs, collect(DISTINCT d1) AS dds1
OPTIONAL MATCH (d2:DecisionDisposition) WHERE d2.targetTdocNumber = 'R3-260313'
WITH packs, dds1 + collect(DISTINCT d2) AS dds
WITH packs, [d IN dds WHERE
  replace(replace(replace(toLower(coalesce(toString(d.dispositionCode), '')), '_', ''), '-', ''), ' ', '') =~ '.*(withdraw|nottreated|notpursued|reject|notagreed|notapproved|nothandled|withoutapproval).*'
  AND NOT replace(replace(replace(toLower(coalesce(toString(d.evidenceStatus), '')), '_', ''), '-', ''), ' ', '') =~ '.*(unverified|notverified|notfound|missing|unresolved|insufficient|absent).*'
] AS closing
UNWIND (CASE
  WHEN size(packs) > 0 THEN [p IN packs | [p.crPackId, p.tsgMeeting]]
  WHEN size(closing) > 0 THEN []
  ELSE [['INSUFFICIENT_RECORDS', 'INSUFFICIENT_RECORDS']]
END) AS row
RETURN DISTINCT row[0] AS cr_pack, row[1] AS tsg_meeting
